text: Visitor reviews over the last 30 days indicate issues with the food quality and menu options at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests found the salads either lacking flavor or having unusual combinations, and the venison chili was described as bland. One review mentioned the food as overpriced and minimal, with a complaint about the lack of cups for water. Service was also noted once, suggesting some dissatisfaction. Overall, the average rating was low, highlighting a need to address these concerns.

windows.60: Recent visitor feedback highlights concerns about the quality and value of the food offerings, with several reviews describing salads as lacking flavor and some dishes as bland or awkwardly combined. There are also complaints about pricing and limited service, including the refusal to provide cups for water. Wait times and menu variety were mentioned but less frequently. Overall, the average rating is just above 3, indicating mixed experiences that suggest a need to review and improve the food and service aspects.
windows.90: Visitor reviews over the last 90 days indicate ongoing issues with the food service at the Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library. Several guests reported bland or poorly prepared dishes, limited menu options, and dissatisfaction with the quality and variety of offerings. There were also complaints about long wait times and inconsistent service, including delays caused by kitchen backups. Some visitors felt the food was overpriced given the portion sizes and quality. Attention to improving the menu and streamlining food service operations could address these concerns.
